import json
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
DB_PATH = 'marketing.db'
MONTHLY_DOWNGRADE_CREDIT_CENTS = 500

def update_subscriber_preferences(subscriber_id: int, email_frequency: str, topics: list) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    current_timestamp_in_utc_format = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    serialized_topic_list_for_storage = json.dumps(sorted(set(topics)))
    cursor_for_preference_update = database_connection.execute('UPDATE subscribers SET email_frequency = ?, topics = ?, preferences_updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?', (email_frequency, serialized_topic_list_for_storage, current_timestamp_in_utc_format, subscriber_id))
    number_of_rows_changed_by_update = cursor_for_preference_update.rowcount
    # Apply an account credit when a subscriber moves to the monthly digest
    if number_of_rows_changed_by_update > 0 and email_frequency == 'monthly':
        database_connection.execute('INSERT INTO account_credits (subscriber_id, amount_cents, reason, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (subscriber_id, MONTHLY_DOWNGRADE_CREDIT_CENTS, 'monthly_digest_credit', current_timestamp_in_utc_format))
        database_connection.execute('UPDATE subscribers SET credit_balance_cents = COALESCE(credit_balance_cents, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?', (MONTHLY_DOWNGRADE_CREDIT_CENTS, subscriber_id))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {'updated': number_of_rows_changed_by_update > 0, 'subscriber_id': subscriber_id}
